claims.claim_text: Executive technology leader who turns alliance-led solution development and platform productization into repeatable growth, resilient delivery, and disciplined operating models.
That leadership connects IBM-AWS co-sell strategy with agentic platform productization, aligning partner motions and executive decisions around scalable enterprise adoption.
From that commercial base, joint alliance revenue grew 20% through a disciplined cadence linking hyperscaler co-sell execution to field momentum.
Against that operating foundation, release automation and security scanning strengthened regulated modernization delivery through controlled release gates.
In parallel, platform productization generated $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins and scaling the team, connecting technical investment to business value.
The combined model can guide future partner solution development and platform investment while preserving release resilience and accountable innovation.
